$comment: Source-of-truth mapping from a desktop icon component (lib/ui/icons/<name>.tsx) to its Icons V3 source icon (the component/instance name in the Figma section defined in figma-icons.config.json). SEED ONLY — this is intentionally incomplete. Later phases extend it, verifying each entry against rendered art before shipping. Chevrons are excluded on purpose (they stay on the legacy pack per design).

status.migrated: already swapped to V3 art in lib/ui/icons
status.verified: V3 source confirmed against rendered art
status.proposed: likely match from name/iOS precedent — must be eyeballed before use
status.bespoke: Vultisig-specific glyph with no V3 counterpart — stays hand-drawn

sourceLegend.station: already shipped in StationFigmaIcons.tsx (drawn in V3 style)
sourceLegend.ios: matches an icon rebuilt on V3 in vultisig-ios#4834
